description: Cross-language contract fixture for the chat goal state. When auto-continue stands down, the worker stores one of stand_down_reason_codes in goal.last_evaluation.stand_down_reason (backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/runs/worker.py); check_failure_codes are the ones where the goal could not be checked. Clearing a met goal writes the goal_outcome channel in the same checkpoint, and every other goal write removes it (runtime/goal.py write_thread_goal); clients cannot write it. The POST /api/threads/{thread_id}/history head carries at most history_head_keys, projecting goal only while it is active and goal_outcome only when achieved. host_reason_texts are the English last_evaluation.reason values the host writes itself instead of the evaluator; the evaluator_failed reason embeds an exception type name and is covered by check_failure_codes. The frontend reads the same file so it never shows a raw code and never labels host text as the evaluator's.
host_reason_texts: No visible assistant evidence is available yet.
The turn ended on a question to the user that has not been answered.
No durable assistant end-of-turn receipt was available.
